stories.title: TFF, savcılığın bu uyarısını neden kulak ardı etti?

en.title: TFF, why did it ignore this prosecutor's warning?
en.summary: Istanbul's chief prosecutor stated that the Turkish Football Federation did not fully comply with instructions in ongoing betting investigations.

stories.title: Mabel Matiz'e şok iddianame: 'Ha Leylim' şarkısı ve klibi yüzünden hapsi isteniyor

en.title: Shock indictment for Mabel Matiz: imprisonment sought over 'Ha Leylim' song and music video
en.summary: Singer Mabel Matiz faces prosecution over the music video and lyrics of the song 'Ha Leylim' published on digital platforms.

en.title: Konyaaltı Mayor Cem Kotan resigns after CHP calls for his expulsion
en.summary: Konyaaltı Mayor Cem Kotan announced his resignation from the Republican People's Party following the party's central management board's request for his dismissal.

stories.title: Müstehcenlik suçlamasında gerekçe 'dans sahnesi' oldu... Mabel Matiz'in klibi hakkında iddianame hazırlandı

en.title: Indictment prepared over Mabel Matiz's music video, with 'dance scene' cited as grounds for obscenity charge
en.summary: An investigation into artist Mabel Matiz's music video for 'Ha Leylim' has been completed and an indictment has been filed against the artist.

stories.title: Konyaaltı Belediye Başkanı, CHP’den istifa etti

en.title: Konyaaltı Mayor Resigns from CHP
en.summary: The mayor of Antalya's Konyaaltı district resigned from the CHP after being referred to disciplinary proceedings by the party's central management board with a formal expulsion request.

stories.title: Kırıkkale Belediyesi'nde rüşvet operasyonu: 3 çalışan gözaltında

en.title: Bribery Operation at Kırıkkale Municipality: 3 Employees in Custody
en.summary: Three municipal workers from Kırıkkale Municipality's Urban Planning Department were detained in connection with a bribery investigation.

stories.title: MSB'den Yunanistan-GKRY elektrik kablosu açıklaması: 'İzinsiz hiçbir faaliyete izin vermeyeceğiz'

en.title: Defense Ministry Statement on Greece-TRNC Electricity Cable: 'We Will Not Permit Any Unauthorized Activity'
en.summary: Turkey's Defense Ministry stated that any activities conducted in its continental shelf must be coordinated beforehand, declaring it will not allow unauthorized operations in the area.

stories.title: Son dakika | MSB'den Yunanistan ve GKRY'ye 'elektrik güzergahı' uyarısı: Kıta sahanlığımızda hiçbir faaliyete izin verilmeyecek

en.title: Turkish Defense Ministry warns Greece and Northern Cyprus over 'electricity corridor': No activities will be permitted in continental shelf
en.summary: Turkey's Defense Ministry issued a warning regarding an electricity cable route between Greece and Northern Cyprus, stating that no cable or pipeline installation activities will be allowed in Turkey's continental shelf under international law.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA… Mersin Büyükşehir Belediyesi’ne yolsuzluk operasyonunda Ali Mahir Başarır ve Veli Ağbaba detayı: İstekleri bitmiyor...

en.title: Breaking news... Details emerge about Ali Mahir Başarır and Veli Ağbaba in corruption operation against Mersin Metropolitan Municipality: Their requests never end
en.summary: A bribery and corruption investigation by Mersin's Chief Prosecutor's office into Mersin Metropolitan Municipality involves several officials including the Metropolitan Mayor Vahap Seçer and other municipal leaders.

stories.title: Kırıkkale Belediyesine yönelik rüşvet operasyonu: 3 belediye çalışanı gözaltına alındı

en.title: Bribery operation targeting Kırıkkale Municipality: 3 municipal employees detained
en.summary: Three municipal employees from Kırıkkale Municipality's Planning and Urban Development Department were taken into custody during a bribery investigation.

stories.title: Son dakika... Mersin'de 3 belediye başkanı dahil 59 kişi gözaltına alınmıştı! Yeni detaylar ortaya çıktı: 'Ali ve Veli'nin istekleri bitmiyor'

en.title: Breaking news... 59 people including 3 municipal mayors detained in Mersin! New details emerged: 'Ali and Veli's requests never end'
en.summary: A corruption investigation by Mersin's Chief Prosecutor into three municipalities resulted in the detention of 59 suspects including three mayors, with an expert report identifying approximately 331 million Turkish lira in public damages from 13 tenders.

stories.title: Micron’da yapay zekâ talebi 32 milyar dolara çıktı

en.title: Artificial intelligence demand at Micron reaches 32 billion dollars
en.summary: Micron's long-term customer commitments increased from 22 billion to 32 billion dollars in three months, driven by artificial intelligence-related memory demand. The company's revenue rose to 54.23 billion dollars and exceeded expectations for the next quarter.

stories.title: Fed için faiz hesabı değişiyor: Borsa, dolar ve tahvil de masada

en.title: Fed's interest rate calculation changes: Stock market, dollar and bonds on the table
en.summary: Global central banks are focusing on broader financial conditions when making interest rate decisions. Rising US bond yields have reduced pressure on the Federal Reserve, suggesting markets may have achieved significant financial tightening needed to cool the economy.

stories.title: Euro dolara karşı 17 ayın dibinde: Faiz artışı beklentisi yetmedi

en.title: Euro at 17-month low against dollar: Interest rate increase expectations not enough
en.summary: The euro fell to its lowest level against the dollar since May 2025 amid global market pressures. Energy costs, rising bond yields, and political risks in Europe are weighing on the common currency despite expectations for European Central Bank rate increases.

stories.title: Aksa Enerji’den 2029 hedefi: Kurulu güç 6 bin 200 MW’a çıkacak

en.title: Aksa Enerji's 2029 target: Installed capacity to reach 6,200 MW
en.summary: Aksa Enerji plans to increase its installed capacity from 3,700 MW to 6,200 MW by 2029 and raise EBITDA to 841 million dollars through ongoing investments. The company also plans to distribute dividends from 2027 net earnings.

stories.title: Depremde hasar gören 6 tarihi cami yeniden açılıyor: İlk cuma namazı yarın

en.title: 6 historic mosques damaged in earthquake reopening: First Friday prayer tomorrow
en.summary: Six restored mosques in Diyarbakır and Bingöl, damaged in the February 6 earthquakes, will reopen for worship on October 2. The restoration work preserved original architectural and artistic features while repairing earthquake damage.
